thread:
sam: paging: spike in 502/timeout errors from inference-prod around 12:03 UTC. Dashboard shows error-rate ~14% for text-gen endpoints. tagging oncall. incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-045 (severity: high) - assigned to @maria.

maria: picking this up. quick triage: which models/regions?

jordan: looks like us-west1 and eu-central, primarily the generic-gpt-4x-large variant. upstream 502s from runtime, not LB (502 from grpc proxy). logs show repeated 'KV cache miss' followed by oom-ish GC in the worker process.

olivia: customer impact: started at ~12:01. We're seeing user-facing failures (requests failing with 502) and some heavy retries. Preliminary estimate: ~12-15% of production requests, mostly non-streaming completions.

maria: mitigation plan (fast path): 1) roll traffic off gpt-4x-large to gpt-4x-medium variant via routing policy (reduce memory pressure). 2) restart affected worker pool in us-west1. 3) enable prefix caching throttle to reduce KV cache churn. Doing canaries first.

lee: giving the canary a try: route 10% -> medium in us-west1 now.

incident-bot: ROUTE CHANGE: 10% traffic -> gpt-4x-medium (us-west1) by maria at 12:10 UTC.

sam: remeasuring: error rate dropped from 14% -> 9% in the canary subset. good sign. continue.

maria: escalating to 50% if stable for 2 min.

olivia: drafting status page update. suggested: "Investigating degraded response rates for text generation in US-West and EU-Central. Some requests return 502. We are routing traffic to a compatible model variant and restarting affected workers. Customers may experience intermittent failures; updates every 15m." Thoughts?

jordan: shorten to single line for status page: "Partial outage: text-generation service degraded in US-West and EU-Central; mitigation in progress." then add details in the incident body.

cs-bot: SUGGESTED CUSTOMER MESSAGE (Zendesk macro):
Hi {{customer.name}},

Thanks for the report — we’re currently investigating an issue causing intermittent failures for text generation requests in some regions. Our engineers have identified a degraded worker pool and are routing traffic to alternative model variants to restore service. We expect to have broader mitigation in the next ~30 minutes and will update you every 15 minutes.

We apologize for the disruption. If you need a targeted workaround (e.g., pin to a specific model variant or region), reply with your account id and we can apply a temporary route.

— Redwood Inference Support

maria: quick internal reply macro for urgent customers (Intercom):
Hi <customer>, we’re actively mitigating a production issue impacting text generation. We’ve applied traffic routing to reduce errors and are restarting affected workers. ETA ~30m. Please share affected endpoints or request ids if you need priority handling.

sam: operations checklist I'm running (copied from playbook):
- [ ] Confirm alarm and incident created (done)
- [ ] Identify impacted regions/models (us-west1, eu-central, gpt-4x-large)
- [ ] Canare route to fallback model variant (started)
- [ ] Restart worker pools (in progress: scheduling rolling restarts)
- [ ] Verify KV cache and memory metrics (watching)
- [ ] If persistent, scale up pool by +2 nodes or enable burst-swap.
- [ ] Draft status page & customer macros (olivia/maria)
- [ ] Postmortem owner (assign after mitigation)

jordan: logs snippet (from us-west1 worker):
```
[12:02:14] WARN kv_cache: eviction pressure high, miss_rate=0.37
[12:02:15] ERROR runtime: worker panic: runtime: out of memory during attention kernel allocate
[12:02:15] INFO worker: restarting process id=4823
```

maria: that oom log matches node memory saturation when gpt-4x-large handled many long-context requests. We'll reroute and restart progressively.

incident-bot: UPDATE: Traffic routed 50% -> gpt-4x-medium in us-west1 at 12:14 UTC by maria.

sam: monitoring: total error-rate down to 6% overall. streaming unaffected. keep pushing to 100% if stable for 5m.

olivia: STATUS PAGE UPDATE DRAFT: 
Investigating — Partial service degradation for text-generation (US-West, EU-Central). We have rerouted traffic to compatible model variants and are performing rolling restarts of worker pools. Customers may experience intermittent 502 errors. Next update in 15 minutes.

maria: internal comms note for SRE handoff (for the next on-call):
- Incident: INC-2026-045. Root cause: worker OOM under gpt-4x-large during heavy long-context requests -> KV cache eviction cascade.
- Actions taken: 50% traffic rerouted to gpt-4x-medium; rolling restarts started in us-west1; watch mem/cpu/kv-miss dashboards.
- Next steps: complete full rollout to fallback model across regions, confirm no regression, scale pool if needed, start RCA.

lee: handoff ack. I’ll own shifts 12:30-14:30 UTC. if error rate creeps back up >8% revert to previous policy and scale.

olivia: CS macro variants to paste into Zendesk (short + technical):

MACRO: INCIDENT_TECHNICAL

We identified an OOM cascade in worker pools serving the gpt-4x-large variant. As an immediate mitigation we’ve routed traffic to gpt-4x-medium and are performing rolling restarts. If you depend on a specific model or region, let us know and we can pin traffic temporarily.

sam: note for support agents: when replying include request id and region if customer provides; escalate VIPs to @maria directly.

incident-bot: NOTE: Next automated status update scheduled in 15 minutes.

maria: taking logs and metrics collection now. If we hit <3% errors and stable for 10m, we'll close the incident as mitigated and open RCA.

olivia: filing a quick 'customer-facing changelog' we can drop into emails for larger accounts after this stabilizes.

jordan: saved heap profiles and core dumps to /mnt/diagnostics/INC-2026-045-12-02 (internal path). Will attach to postmortem.

lee: thumbs for handoff :thumbsup:  (:thumbsup: 4)

sam: good work. keep updates short in this thread so CS can copy macros verbatim.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation progressed, error-rate trending down at 12:28 UTC.

sam: last: 2% errors now after rolling to fallback across both regions. closing soon and opening RCA.

maria: closing incident on symptom; RCA owner: jordan. will set timeline for postmortem. thanks everyone.
